items.name: sfx_stamp_char
items.text: a single wooden seal stamp pressed firmly onto lacquered wood, short deep thud, dry, close

items.name: sfx_cowrie_drop
items.text: three small seashells dropping and clinking onto a polished wooden counter, close, crisp

items.name: sfx_pay_chime
items.text: a soft short modern payment confirmation chime, warm two-note, generic, no voice

items.name: sfx_rewind
items.text: a tape rewind whoosh accelerating backwards, cinematic, airy, 1.5 seconds

items.name: sfx_title_hit
items.text: a deep taiko drum hit layered with a bronze temple bell ring, cinematic impact with long tail

items.name: sfx_waves_shells
items.text: distant gentle sea waves with a handful of seashells rattling in a palm

items.name: sfx_bronze_pour
items.text: molten bronze pouring into a stone mould, hiss and sizzle, then a soft metallic ring as it cools

items.name: sfx_guess_tick
items.text: four soft wooden clock ticks, slow, suspenseful, dry room

items.name: sfx_reveal_shimmer
items.text: a bright gold leaf shimmer with a small high bell, magical reveal, short

items.name: sfx_spade_soil
items.text: an old bronze spade pushed into soft soil, earthy crunch

items.name: sfx_coins_hand
items.text: a few ancient bronze coins jingling in a hand, close

items.name: sfx_balance_settle
items.text: small brass scale pans clinking and swinging, then settling still

items.name: sfx_silk_swish
items.text: a soft silk cloth swish passing close to the microphone, gentle whoosh

items.name: sfx_iron_drag
items.text: a heavy string of iron coins dragging on stone ground with metallic clanks, heavy and slow

items.name: sfx_paper_flutter
items.text: a single sheet of thin paper fluttering lightly in the air

items.name: sfx_crowd_dispute
items.text: a small crowd of people arguing in a tense murmur indoors, indistinct, no words

items.name: sfx_woodblock_print
items.text: a woodblock printing press: a firm wooden thump, then paper peeled off the block

items.name: sfx_paper_crumble
items.text: old brittle paper crumbling into small flakes that scatter, dry rustle

items.name: sfx_silver_clink
items.text: a silver ingot set down on a brass scale pan, bright small clink

items.name: sfx_night_stall
items.text: quiet modern city night street ambience near a noodle stall, soft sizzle, distant traffic, no music

items.name: sfx_trust_swell
items.text: a warm soft cinematic swell rising, gentle shimmer, emotional, no drums

items.name: sfx_seal_paper
items.text: a red ink seal stamped onto thick paper, soft thump
